The requested `main` branch is not available locally; the repository is at a detached HEAD and has a `master` branch. I won’t assume `master` is equivalent to `main`.

May I use `master` as the base for the new branch, or would you prefer to make `main` available?

entries.value: git remote -v; git show-ref --heads --tags; git log -1 --format='%h %s' master; git log -1 --format='%h %s' HEAD; find igel tests -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort
